item.title: F2 title hopeful Dunne completes IndyCar test
item.description: Alpine junior driver Alex Dunne is in a three-way fight for the Formula 2 title [Getty Images] Formula 2 title challenger Alex Dunne has completed an IndyCar test in Alabama as he contemplates a move to the USA in 2027. Ireland's Dunne is an Alpine junior driver and is in a three-way fight for the Formula 2 title, which supports Formula 1 on Grand Prix weekends. The 20-year-old has one win and nine podiums in his second F2 season and is 18 points behind F1-bound leader Rafael Camara with two more rounds scheduled in Qatar and Abu Dhabi. But with seats in F1 limited for 2027, Dunne has tested an IndyCar for Dale Coyne Racing at Barber Motorsports Park on Monday. He has also been linked to a third season in F2 as he chases his Formula 1 dream, but if he wins the championship he cannot return to the series next year. Dunne posted the fastest time in the morning session that included American-born Conor Daly, who is the son of Irish former Formula 1 driver Derek. Dale Coyne Racing have not announced their driver plans for 2027, and American teenager Nikita Johnson tested alongside Dunne on Monday. "The car, the track, everything. I loved it all," Dunne told American outlet RACER. "To be honest, the car was super cool. I think definitely got quite a bit more power, a lot more downforce than what I'm used to. "To jump in and be comfortable pretty quickly, and I think I was quickest when I when I got out of the car in the morning, I really enjoyed it." Dunne wins in Baku to surge into F2 title race Brazilian Camara to join Haas for F1 debut in 2027 IndyCar is the leading open-wheel racing series in the USA, and ex-Formula 1 drivers such as Mick Schumacher, Marcus Ericsson and Romain Grosjean all raced in the series last year. The biggest IndyCar race is the Indianapolis 500, which takes place every May in front of more than 230,000 spectators and is considered one of motorsport's 'Triple Crown' events, alongside Formula 1's Monaco Grand Prix and the Le Man 24 Hours endurance race. Britain's Louis Foster will drive for Rahal Letterman Lanigan Racing for the full 2027 campaign, while Katherine Legge and Jack Harvey both raced at the Indy 500 last year in one-off outings. With the success of Spanish five-time IndyCar champion Alex Palou, the 2027 calendar will return to Europe with a round in Barcelona in July, and the rest of the season takes place on street courses, ovals and more traditional circuits in the USA and Canada. Despite having only one morning testing in an IndyCar, Dunne said he "definitely likes what I've seen so far" and it was a series that had always interested him. "I think naturally, with the path that I've been on and what I've worked towards, the goal will always be to be a Formula 1 driver," he said.. "I think there comes a time when, realistically, that chance becomes more difficult, and I've always said that the next best option for me and the thing I'd love to do most has always been IndyCar."

item.title: Ayush Badoni slams unbeaten century as Delhi take control against Jharkhand
item.description: Ayush Badoni steered Delhi to a commanding position on the opening day of their Ranji Trophy Elite Group C clash at JSCA International Stadium Complex in Ranchi on Monday. Opting to bat, Delhi ended the day at 309/5, thanks largely to an unbeaten century from Badoni and his decisive sixth-wicket partnership with Sumit Mathur. The in-form Badoni continued his prolific run, scoring 106 off 122 balls with 11 fours and two sixes. It was the Delhi skipper’s sixth first-class century and second of the season, following his maiden double hundred against Gujarat in the previous round. He had begun the campaign by scoring 85 against Bengal in a losing cause. Badoni walked in with Delhi’s score at 143/4 during the second session. The visitors slipped further to 181/5 before Badoni joined hands with Mathur to wrest back control for the team. The pair stitched together an unbroken 128-run stand, frustrating the Jharkhand attack. Mathur complemented his captain perfectly, remaining unbeaten on 50 from 119 deliveries. item.title: Mbappe within touching distance of Real Madrid’s all-time top 20 goalscorers
item.description: Mbappe within touching distance of Real Madrid’s all-time top 20 goalscorers Kylian Mbappe has reached 100 goals for Real Madrid after scoring twice in Sunday’s 2-1 El Clasico victory over Barcelona at the Spotify Camp Nou, bringing the French forward closer to breaking into the club’s all-time top 20 goalscorers. The milestone came in a memorable setting, with Mbappe continuing his remarkable scoring run since arriving in Madrid in 2024. The 100-goal mark places Mbappe alongside some of Real Madrid’s most prolific forwards in terms of scoring speed. With his tally continuing to rise, the former Paris Saint-Germain star now has several historic club records within reach. Mbappe reaches 100 Real Madrid goals in just 116 matches Mbappe needed only 116 appearances to score his first 100 goals for Real Madrid, a feat achieved faster by just four players in the club’s history. Mbappe is within touching distance of reaching the top 20 goalscorers in Real Madrid history. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) As such, Ferenc Puskas reached the milestone in 100 matches, Cristiano Ronaldo in 106, Pahino in 111 and Alfredo Di Stefano in 114. Mbappe, meanwhile, reached the landmark ahead of Hugo Sanchez, who needed 142 appearances, Ronaldo Nazário with 163 and Ivan Zamorano with 165. His goals have come across multiple competitions. The breakdown credits him with 67 in La Liga, 25 in the Champions League, four in the Copa del Rey and one each in the Spanish Super Cup, Club World Cup, Intercontinental Cup and UEFA Super Cup. Mbappe scored 44 goals in his first season, 42 in the following campaign and 14 so far this season. Real Madrid all-time scoring chart offers Mbappe next target Mbappe is listed as Real Madrid’s 23rd-highest goalscorer, level with Fernando Morientes on 100 goals. Mbappe scored a brace against Barcelona. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) His next milestone is Sergio Ramos and Zamorano’s tally of 101, followed by the 104 goals scored by Ronaldo Nazario and Jose Molowny, which would bring him into the top 20 under the ranking provided. Gareth Bale’s 106 goals are another nearby target, while Gonzalo Higuain and Juanito sit further ahead on 121. Given Mbappe’s current scoring rate, he has a realistic opportunity to climb the rankings this season. The bigger question is how far he can rise during his Real Madrid career, with the club’s all-time scoring record held by Cristiano Ronaldo at 450 goals.

item.title: Spain coach Luis de la Fuente backs Barcelona star to win multiple Ballon d’Or awards: ‘He should rest easy’
item.description: Spain coach Luis de la Fuente backs Barcelona star to win multiple Ballon d’Or awards: ‘He should rest easy’ Barcelona superstar Lamine Yamal has already established himself among the world’s best footballers at just 19 years old. However, despite another remarkable year for club and country, the youngster will have to wait longer to claim his first Ballon d’Or. The Barcelona attacker finished third in the rankings, behind Harry Kane and Kylian Mbappe, but secured the Kopa Trophy for the third consecutive time. Spain manager Luis de la Fuente has offered words of encouragement to the Barcelona winger following Monday’s ceremony in London. De la Fuente confident of future wins for Lamine Yamal De la Fuente expressed complete confidence that La Roja ‘s star attacker will eventually win football’s most prestigious award. “Lamine is going to win many Ballons d’Or. He should rest easy, because we know who he is and the potential he possesses,” De la Fuente told COPE . Understandably for a teenager, missing out on the Ballon d’Or might come as a disappointment to Lamine. Lamine Yamal will get more chances for the Ballon d’Or award. (Photo by Pascal Le Segretain/Getty Images) However, he should look to channel that into motivation to perform even better and make it impossible for anyone else to win the award next year. De la Fuente, who was named Men’s Coach of the Year at the ceremony, can see where Lamine’s potential can take him. Barcelona must continue nurturing their biggest talent The Spain manager’s comments carry particular influence after a difficult week for both Barcelona and Lamine that included defeats against PSG and Real Madrid. The teenager struggled to make his usual impact in Sunday’s Clasico , and despite scoring a goal against PSG, his overall game was quite average. For a player who has made a name for himself by stepping up in the big games, Lamine would not have been proud of the week he had. Luis de la Fuente sees the ceiling that Lamine has in football. (Photo by Alex Livesey/Getty Images) It also shows that, at 19, expecting the Spaniard to be a beacon of consistency week in and week out might be unrealistic for Barça . One disappointing performance does not take away his status as one of the best in the world, but Lamine will be keen to return to his best sooner rather than later. The bigger challenge for Barcelona is to ensure that the pressure of winning the Ballon d’Or does not get to him. At 19, Yamal still has considerable room to improve his decision-making, consistency and goalscoring numbers. Everyone is confident that the Barça teenager will win a few Ballon d’Or awards in the future. The onus is now on him to keep improving and finish higher next season.

item.title: Andoni Iraola puts four top stars on list to replace Virgil van Dijk
item.description: Andoni Iraola puts four top stars on list to replace Virgil van Dijk Liverpool are set for a big shakeup at the end of the current season. By summer 2027 we could be waving goodbye to both Virgil van Dijk and Joe Gomez. The defensive duos contracts expire at the end of the 2026/27 campaign and it’s been relatively quiet so far over possible renewals. Liverpool require Van Dijk successor Van Dijk, 35, would of course be the biggest loss. The Dutchman is a defensive colossus although he is beginning to show signs of slowing down this term. Gomez is a useful squad player - being deployed across the backline by Jurgen Klopp and Arne Slot before Andoni Iraola took over. Should those two leave then there will be a need to sign an experienced defender to go alongside Jeremy Jacquet, Giovanni Leoni and others. Four centre-backs on the list Although Iraola and Julian Ward are building a new generation of top defensive stars the 2024/25 Premier League champions may well be left a little short of experience. And now a report in Football Insider is claiming that FOUR senior options are now on Iraola’s shortlist for when Van Dijk and Gomez exit. “[Nico] Schlotterbeck is one of four players on the Reds' shortlist at centre-back as Virgil van Dijk and Joe Gomez edge towards the end of their contracts next summer,” the report reads. “Nottingham Forest star Murillo is also admired by Liverpool chiefs, as are Inter Milan's Alessandro Bastoni and Barcelona's Jules Kounde.” LFC looking at Schlotterbeck, Murillo, Bastoni and Kounde Schlotterbeck recently renewed his Borussia Dortmund contract but that won’t prevent transfer interest in the 26-year-old German international. Murillo meanwhile is a long-term target who looks ready to take the next step in his promising Premier League career. Bastoni has been consistently linked over the past couple of seasons and could finally be set to depart Inter Milan for pastures new. And rounding out the list is Jules Kounde - who cannot nail down a regular starting berth at Barcelona any longer and may be ready to follow Ronald Araujo to Anfield.

item.title: Paul Scholes explains why Man United must appoint Antonio Conte despite major warning
item.description: Paul Scholes explains why Man United must appoint Antonio Conte despite major warning Manchester United manager Michael Carrick’s future remains uncertain as the club navigates a tricky start to the season. The Red Devils are out of the EFL Cup and are sitting 16th in the Premier League table after eight games. Carrick has been under pressure for a while, and his situation was compounded by a 3-0 defeat to Bournemouth at Old Trafford over the weekend. United have now managed just two wins in 12 games across all competitions under the English manager’s watch this campaign. The situation has intensified speculation about another managerial change. Among the candidates linked with the job is former Chelsea manager Antonio Conte, who recently revealed that he is not in advanced talks with any club. United legend Paul Scholes has now offered his opinion on the matter. Scholes wants Conte at Old Trafford Speaking on The Good, The Bad & The Football , Scholes argued that Conte is the right man to get United back where they belong. He said: “You’d have to pick a manager who you think will get us back to being a competitive team for the Premier League.” “Out of them three, Antonio Conte’s the man, but he comes with a big f***ing massive warning. item.title: One-run defeat sparks controversy! BCCI receives complaint over scorer's blunder
item.description: A scoring error has triggered a major controversy in a Women's Under-19 cricket match between Jharkhand and Uttarakhand in Nagpur. The Jharkhand Cricket Association (JCA) has complained to the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), alleging that a mistake by the official scorer cost the team the match and led to its exit from the tournament. Uttarakhand scored 134/6 while batting first. Jharkhand were then bowled out for 133, according to the official scorecard, and were declared one-run losers. However, the JCA has claimed that the match should have ended in a tie because a run was not added to Jharkhand's total. What went wrong during the match? According to a report in The Indian Express, the controversy centres on an incident in the 30th over of Jharkhand's innings. One of the Jharkhand batters was run out while trying to complete a second run on the fourth ball of the over. The JCA has alleged that the batters had already completed the first run, but the official scorer failed to add it to the team's total. The scoreboard at the ground reportedly showed the updated score. However, the official scorer's records did not include the extra run. Jharkhand thought the match had ended in a tie The difference became crucial in the final moments of the match. Believing they needed two runs to win from the last ball, Jharkhand managed to take a single. The players thought they had levelled the scores. However, they were shocked when the official result showed that they had lost by one run. According to the report, members of the Jharkhand team argued with the official scorer and requested a correction. However, the scorer did not change the decision. Why has Jharkhand complained to the BCCI? A Jharkhand official told The Indian Express that the missing run proved costly, as it changed both the result of the match and the team's tournament campaign. “The scoreboard at the far end had the updated score after each ball but the main scorer forgot to add one run which cost us a tie. We requested the scorer to make the correction but he didn’t. As per the rule, umpires have to go by the scorer and not at the person doing scoring at the scoreboard,” a Jharkhand official told Indian Express. The JCA has now taken up the matter with the BCCI, alleging that the match ended in a tie but was recorded as a one-run defeat because of the scoring mistake. 135226511

item.title: Steve Smith ruled out of third Test with neck injury in huge blow for Australia
item.description: Australia have been dealt a huge injury blow on the first morning of their Test series decider against South Africa with Steve Smith ruled out with a neck injury. Smith had been dealing with the issue since the second Test in Gqeberha but had appeared primed to play in Cape Town as his side looked to bounce back from defeat. But having appeared in discomfort in the nets on match eve, Smith again struggled to bat properly with his neck heavily bandaged on the first morning, and was scratched from the Australia XI as one of four changes. "He had another little try this morning but wasn't happy with how his neck was feeling, so we had to look elsewhere,” captain Pat Cummins explained of Smith’s injury. “We've got some guys really well-placed; they've been here working hard the last couple of weeks. A couple of injuries they're coming back from and they're now 100 per cent." Smith had been forced to drop down the order in the second innings as Australia sought, and failed, to save the Test in Gqeberha. Josh Inglis is the beneficiary of the 37-year-old’s absence and will bolster the middle order, with Cameron Green , Cooper Connolly and Nathan Lyon also returning to the side. Matt Renshaw will move up to open alongside Travis Head with Nic Maddinson dropped, while Scott Boland is unfortunate to miss out for Lyon having been a standout performer in the second Test defeat. The three-match series is tied at 1-1 in the first meeting of the two teams on South African soil since the Sandpaper-gate saga of 2018. Australia elected to bowl first at Newlands with the hosts bringing in seamer Gerald Coetzee for an injured Anrich Nortje.

item.title: Miami Heat star directly tells Bam Adebayo what he needs to improve after disastrous 0-4 start
item.description: Photo by Melissa Tamez/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images The Miami Heat have started the season 0-4, and there is a lot of frustration about how Bam Adebayo has played this season. Adebayo was once considered the Heat’s first option, given how strong a scorer he is. The man who holds the record for the second-most points scored in a game has not shown anywhere near the same scoring prowess to start the season. While new arrival Giannis Antetokounmpo has been at his stellar best, the same cannot be said about his frontcourt partner, who has failed to make an impact this season. Davion Mitchell tells Bam Adebayo to be ‘more aggressive’ to overcome scoring slump Speaking to reporters after the Miami Heat’s loss to the Dallas Mavericks, Davion Mitchell was asked about what he can do to help Bam Adebayo overcome his scoring slump. While Mitchell admitted that he has to get Adebayo the ball in the paint, he did call on Bam to be more aggressive as a scorer. “Obviously, the paint and getting more easy looks. I have to do a better job of not letting him get lost in the game, but he also has to be intentional. He has got to be more aggressive. “He’s still trying to figure it out. Him and Giannis play in the same spaces so when Giannis is on the floor with him, he can’t be in those same spaces. “But this is something he’ll get used to. I don’t want to keep saying it is early, but it is. I think we’re still going to figure it out.” Adebayo has been incredibly inefficient to start the season, averaging just 11.8 points, 7.3 rebounds, 3.5 assists, 2.0 steals, and 0.8 blocks per game while shooting 40.0% from the field and 16.7% from beyond the arc. With Giannis Antetokounmpo now becoming the first offensive option for the Heat, perhaps Adebayo is struggling with his new role on the Miami Heat and trying to adapt. item.description: Sam Johnstone shakes off culture shock of Glasgow Derby nightmare Sam Johnstone shakes off culture shock of Glasgow Derby nightmare as he looks to the future aiming to be the first pick Celtic goalkeeper… Sam Johnstone of Celtic warms up before the UEFA Europa League match between Celtic FC and Real Club Celta at Celtic Park on October 22, 2026. item.title: What is the latest on Michael Carrick’s future at Manchester United?
item.description: What is the latest on Michael Carrick’s future at Manchester United? Michael Carrick appeared to be on the brink of the sack following Manchester United’s 3-0 home defeat against Bournemouth on Sunday. Many expected the club to make a formal announcement of his departure on Monday, but that did not happen. Now The Athletic’s Laurie Whitwell reports Carrick is expected to take training of his squad on Tuesday. There are no guarantees he will remain in charge for United’s next match at Chelsea this weekend. The club’s decision makers are holding crunch talks over Carrick’s future but they have not reached a final decision yet. Man United have already sounded out potential replacements for the 45-year-old. Eddie Howe is said to be in pole to land the Old Trafford role, with director of football Jason Wilcox favouring his appointment. Julian Nagelsmann is also regarded as a top contender. He is available for hire after stepping down as Germany head coach following their early World Cup exit. Fabian Hurzeler and Unai Emery have been linked with United, but their clubs would demand significant compensation. United should not sack Carrick Under Carrick, the Red Devils have made a horrible start to the 2026-27 season. They are currently just a point above the relegation zone, having won just one of their eight Premier League matches. But the English boss is not solely to blame for the poor results. The club’s hierarchy did not back him in the transfer market, refusing to sign even a striker or a left-back. The players are not giving their 100 percent on the pitch. Instead of looking at their own performances, they are busy blaming the coach and the club’s board in interviews. Sacking Carrick will not solve United’s problems. They have deeper structural issues and this approach of constantly changing managers has failed. The club have appointed several top managers since Sir Alex Ferguson’s retirement in 2013, but all of them have failed to deliver success.

item.title: Several Chinese brands cut ties with Mbappé after dictator meme comments
item.description: At least three Chinese companies have ended their agreements with Kylian Mbappé after the French soccer star made comments apparently referring to Mao Zedong , the founding leader of Communist China, as a dictator. Dongpeng, a beverage maker, dairy giant Mengniu and cheese maker Milkground all announced the terminations on Tuesday. Each company issued a similarly worded statement, saying they oppose “any words and actions that hurt national sentiment.” The statements came after a clip circulated on X that appeared to show Mbappé being interviewed ahead of an appearance on the French online talk show “The Bridge” In the video, Mbappé is asked about his favorite meme of himself. The soccer star replies that it was “a video someone made of a guy ... I think he was a Chinese dictator” before the video shows an altered image depicting Mbappé's face on the blue-suited body of Mao Zedong. The companies did not specify what prompted their decisions. A bus featuring French football star Kylian Mbappe for Dongpeng Beverage Group's 'Bushuila' electrolyte drink is seen on a street in Shanghai on October 27, (AFP/Getty) Mbappé's face has appeared in ads across China, from subway stations to elevators. He has featured in Chinese advertising campaigns for products ranging from electrolyte drinks to milk and cheese. In one commercial for Dongpeng, Mbappé delivers a slogan in Chinese. In an ad for Mengniu, he appears alongside Argentine soccer star Lionel Messi . Soccer fans online jokingly call the star a dictator, saying he is said to overshadow many of his teammates and even the teams he plays on, and memes showing him as Mao or other autocratic leaders are widely circulated. RedNote, a social media platform, joined the criticism in a separate statement. The company said it had a content partnership with Mbappé that ended on Dec. 31, 2024, and that it would “remove related promotional materials.” It likewise expressed opposition to “any conduct that hurts national sentiment.” On Chinese social media, there were already several comments criticizing the soccer star. The hashtags “Dongpeng ends partnership with Mbappé” and “Several brands end partnerships with Mbappé” topped Weibo 's trending list. “Football fans boycott Mbappé” was also trending, with some users expressing anger at his remarks or telling him not to come to China. The Associated Press was immediately unable to reach Mbappé's representatives for comment. Associated Press video producer Olivia Zhang contributed to this report from Beijing .

item.description: Julian Alvarez - Getty Images Former Argentina striker Maxi Lopez believes Julian Alvarez made a mistake joining Atletico Madrid and should have signed for Barcelona instead. The ex-Catania star claimed broken promises in the Spanish capital are hindering the forward, suggesting a move to Catalonia would have elevated his game to another level. Lopez questions Alvarez move Lopez has publicly questioned Alvarez's decision to remain with Atletico. The ex-Barca player believes his compatriot made the wrong choice during a turbulent summer transfer window. Alvarez dominated headlines while away on international duty with Argentina. His future was heavily debated before he ultimately returned to the Spanish capital to play under Diego Simeone. However, Lopez feels the prolific striker would have been much better suited to a different environment. He suggested that joining a club like Barca would have been the optimal career move for the South American star. Broken promises at Atletico The most striking element of Lopez's assessment revolves around alleged behind-the-scenes issues at Atletico. He claimed that the club's hierarchy failed to deliver on early assurances given to the player. "In his moment he sought to leave City to find minutes, because he had the other 'the other alien' [Erling Haaland] next to him and had no space," Lopez explained, as quoted by AS . "He went to Atleti and found minutes. Then there was a chat with the board, things were said and they promised him something that wasn't fulfilled later." Lopez insisted that Alvarez needs a system that perfectly suits his traits,saying: "He is the Argentina national team's number 9, which is why I would have liked to see him at Barcelona. Honestly, I would have liked to see him at another team this summer, because it would develop him more." Familiarity with the Simeone system Lopez is uniquely positioned to evaluate life under Simeone's demanding tactical setup. The pair actually worked together during the 2011 season when both men were at Italian outfit Catania. While Lopez respects his former manager's achievements, he remains unconvinced about the tactical fit for Alvarez. "I am stating a personal preference, and what I see for Julian's projection," Lopez stated. "And I would go to Barcelona. The Englishman watched the game from the bench as Kylian Mbappe’s brace led Madrid to victory. Alexander-Arnold’s late introduction made it clear that he’s not a key part of Mourinho’s plans. The Portuguese manager started Federico Valverde at right back and brought on Denzel Dumfries when the Uruguayan midfielder was injured. Interestingly, Eder Militao has also been deployed at right back, so that’s more competition for Alexander-Arnold in his preferred position. Despite these difficulties, Spanish football journalist Guillem Balague believes Alexander-Arnold is determined to remain in Madrid and fight for his place. Balague has dismissed the possibility of a January move, explaining that the defender understands his current situation and believes his opportunity will eventually arrive. “No, not in January,” Balague said on talkSPORT . “What he’s feeling right now is ‘Okay, it’s not my time, but it will be my time, I will prepare for my time’. That’s how he’s taking the whole thing. “But there are two ahead of him in the same position (Valverde and Dumfries), and in fact, Eder Militao was also used as a right back against Sevilla. So is he fourth choice? He’s certainly third it seems. “But he’s not down, he’s been told by Mourinho to keep at it, he will have his moment.” Since joining Madrid, Alexander-Arnold has made 42 appearances across all competitions, starting 31 matches and recording eight assists. However, he has completed 90 minutes just 15 times.

item.title: Barcelona could face disciplinary action after alleged assault on Real Madrid midfielder during El Clasico
item.description: Barcelona could face disciplinary action after alleged assault on Real Madrid midfielder during El Clasico Barcelona have endured a disappointing week across all fronts, losing to PSG in the Champions League and Real Madrid in La Liga . Their defeat to Los Blancos on Sunday has already raised questions about the team’s dip in form. The consequences of the Clasico loss could now extend beyond the pitch. An incident involving Eduardo Camavinga has attracted the attention of La Liga . According to The Athletic , La Liga intends to report an alleged assault on the Madrid midfielder to the disciplinary committee of the Spanish Football Federation. What happened during Real Madrid’s celebrations? The incident occurred shortly after Kylian Mbappe scored the winner for Madrid, a goal created by Eduardo Camavinga. As Madrid’s players gathered near the Barcelona supporters to celebrate, a spectator was seen swinging a flagpole towards the French midfielder. The situation prompted his teammates to intervene and move him away from the stands. Referee Juan Martinez Munuera also documented the disturbances in his official match report. A water bottle and a Coca-Cola can were thrown from the stands, although neither struck the player. The incident led to a stadium announcement and a temporary stoppage lasting a couple of minutes. Barcelona await potential disciplinary consequences La Liga have now decided to bring the alleged assault to the attention of the disciplinary authorities. They will examine the available evidence and footage to determine whether any sanctions need to be imposed. For Barça , this is yet another unwelcome development, with the results, injury issues and disciplinary problems all piling up at the wrong time. Barcelona could face a disciplinary action. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) The club’s nine-match winning start in La Liga ended on Sunday, with Los Blancos reducing the gap at the top of the standings to just three points. Emotions can naturally run high during a Clasico , but that cannot be used to justify the physical aggression on display. However, the actions of a small number of individuals do not define Barcelona’s wider fanbase, and what happened with Camavinga is unfortunate. The disciplinary process will now determine whether the incident warrants punishment. If sanctioned, Barcelona will hope that it is not too heavy. It remains to be seen how the process pans out, and Barça will hope to put this game behind them as soon as possible and move on.

item.description: Man Utd given Eddie Howe boost as Newcastle’s due compensation slashed Manchester United have learned the amount they’ll have to pay to Newcastle United should they appoint Eddie Howe. After failing to register a win in their last eight games, the Red Devils are expected to part ways with Michael Carrick, especially after suffering embarassing back-to-back defeats to Como (1-4) and Bournemouth (0-3) in the space of four days. Many expected the official decision to come out on Monday following a meeting between CEO Omar Berrada and Director of Football Jason Wilcox, who were also joined by the club’s minority owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe via video call. However, Carrick remains Man Utd’s head coach on Tuesday morning , and he’s expected to handle the next training session. Man Utd must pay £3m Eddie Howe compensation to Newcastle (Photo by Alex Davidson/Getty Images) According to the Telegraph journalist James Ducker, Carrick is not out of the woods just yet, as the official communication could still arrive in the coming hours. Nevertheless, the 45-year-old will resume his duties as normal in the meantime. Over the last few days, Howe has been the big favourite to replace the under-fire Man Utd manager, followed by Julian Nagelsmann and Antonio Conte, in this order. Howe has been unattached since leaving Newcastle in July. At the time, the Geordies agreed to relieve him of his duties at his request, despite the unnatural timing. However, the Magpies added a clause to protect their interests should Howe decide to join another Premier League club. But while earlier reports suggest that Newcastle would collect a £6 million compensation, Ducker reveals that the figure has dropped to £3 million. Is Howe the best candidate for post-Carrick role? (Photo by Dan Istitene/Getty Images) Unfortunately for Man Utd, finding Mr Right has been a perilous mission over the years, and they’re now set for a mid-season managerial change for the third year running. Based on his exploits at Bournemouth and Newcastle, one could argue that Howe might be the best English manager of his generation. Therefore, his profile suits Ratcliffe and Wilcox’s requirements. However, United’s Head of Recruitment, Christopher Vivell, insists that his old RB Leipzig ally Nagelsmann is better prepared for the role thanks to his tenures at Bayern Munich and the German national team. But if the club is seeking a proven winner capable of squeezing the best out of this underachieving squad, Conte should be at the very top of the list. item.title: Lakers Announce Roster Decision on 1st-Rounder Cameron Carr
item.description: Cameron Carr #43 of the Los Angeles Lakers Getty While the Los Angeles Lakers are off to an impressive 3-0 start to the NBA season, there are still some areas of concern around a roster that needs to muster all the youth and depth it can handle as this season goes on. For that reason, it has been somewhat disappointing that the Lakers have not been able to get rookie Cameron Carr on the floor at all, as he is dealing with an oblique injury. Carr is something of an X-factor for the Lakers, a player who was considered to have lottery-level talent entering the draft last June, but who fell out of the lottery as teams focused more on big men and point guards than wings in the mid-to-late teens of the first round. That was a stroke of luck for the Lakers, who picked him at No. 24. But we have not seen Carr since the preseason, after he had averaged 18.0 points during summer league, shooting 42.4% from the field and just 19.2% from the 3-point line. He is a scorer, though, and that’s an aspect the Lakers would like to polish up here in the early going of the season. Carr should get the ability to finally work his way back to the court, though, as the Lakers made an announcement on what’s next for him: He’s going to Coachella Valley of the G League. The Lakers have assigned Cameron Carr to the Coachella Valley Lakers, per the team. — Khobi Price (@khobi_price) October 27, 2026 From Khobi Price of the California Post: “The Lakers have assigned Cameron Carr to the Coachella Valley Lakers, per the team.” Lakers Want to Play Cameron Carr It’s not clear how long the Lakers plan to keep Carr with the G League bunch, but they do not start action until November 6. We’re just naturally deeper. We have the luxury of doing that, if we’re healthy with this roster. So there’s going to be an opportunity for him. Those opportunities may be here and there; he may be part of the rotation.
